== Printed retrieval condition ==
The complete [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf December 2025 publisher sheet], p. 2, and the card image print “landed starfighter”. The matching [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Light.json primary card-data record] (Peli Motto, card 7469) has the same game text, but its derived ruling uses the broader word “starship”. The article now uses “landed starfighter” for this condition, retaining the ruling's “belonging to either player” qualification. The printed game text and card identity are unchanged.
